name: Wolfram Alpha
label: Wolfram Alpha
description: Wolfram Alpha official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: query (Full Results v2), spoken (Spoken Results v1), short_answer (Short Answers v1 /result). Docs: https://products.wolframalpha.com/api/documentation , https://products.wolframalpha.com/spoken-results-api/documentation . AppID query appid=. Results licensed — no unlimited republish. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One Wolfram Alpha request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"query"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: query | spoken | short_answer. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'query'.

schema.label: input
schema.description: Full Results query string. Required on query. Example: pi.

schema.label: i
schema.description: Spoken / short-answer input. Required on spoken and short_answer. Example: weather in paris.

schema.label: format
schema.description: Full results formats, comma-separated. query. Example: plaintext,image. https://products.wolframalpha.com/api/documentation

schema.label: podstate
schema.description: Pod state for query (e.g. Result__Step-by-step solution).

schema.label: assumption
schema.description: Assumption token from a previous query.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: query | spoken | short_answer. Example: 'query'.

configurationParameters.label: Appid
configurationParameters.description: Provider secret. OfficialApiNode auth type `query`. Bind a StudioQuack secret. Never log, never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 30. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
